examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The facts band of a resource detail page: an ID with its copy button, a status, the creation date, a region and a linked domain, in one column.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The same facts at 2, 3 and 4 columns. Below md every grid collapses to one column, and 3 or 4 columns fall back to two at md.

examples.name: Groups
examples.summary: Facts split into titled columns, one group per column. The Region key carries an info hint, and the custom certificate has no value, so it shows the empty-value marker.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: While the data loads, every value becomes a skeleton and the labels stay in place, so the layout does not jump when the values arrive.

examples.name: Split
examples.summary: A subscription plan card with `kind="split"`: each label at the start and its value at the end of one row, the way a summary card reads. The payment method is not set, so it shows the empty-value marker.
